reasons: Cited §§11.1–11.3 satisfy the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance on request, return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and secure deletion with written officer certification thereafter.

Rate basis (rates in the expiring Order Form) is equal or better for the customer than 'then-current rates', and deletion is conditioned on confirmed successful return — no walk-away risk (no immediate deletion, no refusal to return, no fee-dispute hold-back).
Consistent with a compliant claim, no redline or comment was proposed and the rendered text is unchanged; deterministic check confirms a data-return/transition clause is present.
